steps.name: carry-core
steps.summary: Added src/core/time/carry.ts (+carry.test.ts) — pure carry-over logic exporting shiftPlannedToDate (grid-aware date move preserving clock+duration), carryOverNode (shift + carryCount++ + status 'carried'), findOverdueUncarried (idempotent past-due sweep filter); reuses day.ts grid-boundary helpers, no UI/DB imports.

steps.name: action-x-carry
steps.summary: CalendarBlock.tsx: Action ghost ✕ now carries the task to the next day via carryOverNode(node, addDays(selectedDate, 1)) through the existing optimistic useUpdateNode (no direct fetch); aria-label/title → 'Carry to tomorrow'. Removed all 'dropped' display paths — the line-through title style, the ↺ restore button branch, and CalendarGrid.tsx's `action && status==='dropped'` Action-column filter. Plan ✕ (removeNode) and Action real-block ✕ (clear actual) untouched.

steps.name: auto-carry-sweep
steps.summary: Added src/hooks/useCarryOverSweep.ts — runs findOverdueUncarried(nodes, startOfDay(now)) once on first useNodes success and carries each past-due undone task to today via the optimistic useUpdateNode with carryOverNode patch + fromHistory:true (no undo footprint, no direct fetch). Idempotent by two layers: findOverdueUncarried excludes today's nodes (carry.ts) + a useRef guard set BEFORE mutating (survives Strict Mode double-effect and cache-change re-runs). Mounted via a <CarryOverSweep/> null-renderer inside QueryClientProvider in app/providers.tsx. CalendarBlock.tsx: status==='carried' blocks now render with a dashed border (same 'planned, not done' cue as the Action ghost), and carryCount>0 shows a small always-on 🔁{n} badge in the control row (quiet metadata, ADR-009).

steps.name: detail-modal
steps.summary: Added src/components/calendar/NodeDetailModal.tsx — a double-click detail editor that manually reschedules a task's planned and (if recorded) actual span via the reused MiniCalendar. Picks call the optimistic useUpdateNode with shiftPlannedToDate / new carry.ts shiftActualToDate, which preserve clock+duration but never touch carryCount/status (manual reschedule ≠ carry, ADR-009). Also edits title + notes (commit on blur). Accessibility: role=dialog/aria-modal, Esc + backdrop-click close, focus moves to title on open. carry.ts: added shiftActualToDate (+4 tests) and extracted a shared shiftSpanOntoGridDay helper; day.ts: added dayFromKey (inverse of dayKey) so the picker highlights the span's grid day. CalendarBlock.tsx: container onDoubleClick opens the modal (local useState), title textarea stops dblclick bubbling so inline word-select/resize/✕ are not intercepted.
